justifications.r1: Green land ramp and sacrifice mana dorks (Sakura-Tribe Elder, Steve loop).
justifications.r2: Self-mill, dredge, and continuous end-step reanimation provide immense card flow.
justifications.a1: Grave tutors (Buried Alive, Entomb, Jarad's Orders) tutor directly to recursion pool.
justifications.a2: Establishes experience counter reanimation loop on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents reanimation attrition and Gary drain on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps to grind out life totals.
justifications.p3: Graveyard-reliant strategy vulnerable to Rest in Peace / Bojuka Bog.
justifications.i1: Repeatable creature edicts (Plaguecrafter, Spore Frog lock).
justifications.i2: Recurring edicts systematically strip opponents of creature boards.
justifications.s1: Spore Frog loops fog attacks; boots protect Meren.
justifications.s2: Graveyard engine naturally thrives and rebuilds after mass destruction.
justifications.s3: Meren is central engine; hard reanimation spells act as backups.
